opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Funding is paid to the institution via invoice, not to individuals. Cannot be used for salary, conference attendance or membership payments.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds cannot pay staff salaries but may be used for consumables, HEA Fellowship registration or other justified sundries.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Funding cannot be used to buy out teaching time, support salary costs or attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications should be physiological in nature; applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Funding cannot be used to support salary costs or attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer. Funds paid via institution invoice, not to individuals; cannot be used for salary costs or to attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research. Applications closed for 2026 and will reopen in 2027.

opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; value and frequency of award changes with membership category. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting. Awards cover Society meetings (all member categories) and Society-sponsored meetings (Postgraduate, Full and Fellow Members).
opportunities.summary: Provides funding primarily for member engagement at the Society's own meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events, covering registration and a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation.
